name: BriefYourMarket
positioning: Email marketing platform that turns an estate agent's historic client data into targeted, localised lead-generation campaigns.
description: BriefYourMarket is an email marketing platform built for estate and letting agents. It mines an agency's historic contact and transaction data to re-engage past clients and surface valuation opportunities, and runs localised, community-targeted email campaigns from that data, with reporting on the leads and instructions the campaigns generate.
real_estate_use: An estate agency has years of past-client data sitting unused in its CRM and wants to turn it back into instructions without a broad, untargeted newsletter. A marketing lead uses BriefYourMarket to segment that historic database and run localised campaigns — a past seller in a specific postcode who might be ready to move again, for example — and tracks which campaigns actually convert into valuation requests.

use_cases.job: Re-engage past clients from historic data to generate new valuation instructions
Run localised email campaigns targeted at a specific farming area
